target.statement: Asymptotic power of BONuS under the point mass prior, as given by Theorem 1, evaluated at the default setting (γ=0.2, c=0.2, h=4, m=1000) and π_aug=0.5, compared to empirical power from simulation.
target.dataset: Synthetic data generated from the two-groups multivariate normal model with point mass prior (Eq. 1-3)

compute.basis: The target is a single simulation-based power estimate for BONuS at one parameter setting; the paper provides full code, and the computation involves generating m=1000 d-dimensional normal vectors and applying simple matrix operations, which should run in seconds on a CPU.

title: Power of masking methods for adaptive testing in a multivariate normal means problem
